name: 瞬步
description: 灵压。选择5格内1名敌人，传送至其2格内1个空格，并获得1点临时行动点。
targetText: 5格内1名敌人，然后其2格内1个空格
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var enemy = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 5, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!enemy || enemy.needsTargetSelection) return enemy; var pos = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 99, filter: 'all' }); if (!pos || pos.needsTargetSelection) return pos; if (Math.abs(enemy.x - pos.x) + Math.abs(enemy.y - pos.y) > 2) return { success: false, message: '落点超出范围' }; caster.x = pos.x; caster.y = pos.y; var player = battle.players.find(function(item) { return item.playerId === caster.ownerPlayerId; }); if (player) player.actionPoints += 1; return { success: true, message: caster.name + '发动瞬步并获得1点临时行动点' }; }
